project.name: Microsoft Fabric Northwind Platform
project.current_machine_note: Use this file as the handoff checkpoint when resuming on another computer.

full_roadmap.name: Program Foundation
full_roadmap.objective: Define naming, branching, repo standards, architecture decisions, and a risk register before workload creation begins.

full_roadmap.name: Tenant, Admin, Identity, and Automation Baseline
full_roadmap.objective: Stand up the Fabric learning environment foundation and establish repeatable platform engineering practices.

full_roadmap.name: Workspace and Release Foundation
full_roadmap.objective: Provision workspaces, connect development workspaces to Git, and establish deployment pipeline scaffolding.

full_roadmap.name: OneLake and Core Data Platform Foundation
full_roadmap.objective: Create the initial medallion-aligned data platform structure in Fabric.

full_roadmap.name: Batch Ingestion and Orchestration plus Initial BI Consumption
full_roadmap.objective: Bring source data into Fabric through repeatable ingestion patterns and continue current semantic model and report authoring milestone.

full_roadmap.name: Transformation, Incremental Loads, and Data Quality
full_roadmap.objective: Implement engineering logic, quality gates, and sustainable refresh patterns.

full_roadmap.name: Semantic Models, Security, and Reporting Maturity
full_roadmap.objective: Deliver business-facing analytics with governed access, reusable metrics, and security controls such as RLS and OLS.

full_roadmap.name: Real-Time Analytics
full_roadmap.objective: Add streaming or near-real-time capabilities for telemetry and event-based use cases.

full_roadmap.name: Governance and Catalog Maturity
full_roadmap.objective: Make the platform discoverable, auditable, and manageable at scale.

full_roadmap.name: Security Hardening and Network Maturity
full_roadmap.objective: Move from learning-safe patterns to stronger enterprise controls.

full_roadmap.name: Capacity, Performance, and Operations
full_roadmap.objective: Prepare the platform for sustained production operations.

full_roadmap.name: Production Readiness and Transition
full_roadmap.objective: Validate transition from trial-era learning mode into a controlled enterprise delivery model.

completed: Phase 1 tenant baseline, identity groups, Git and CI/CD foundation
